ArtifactGeneration.description:
Content-derived identity of one coherent schema/function artifact pair.
It deliberately excludes the process-local publication counter: callers
learn these values from generated artifacts and can refetch them after a
deployment race.

DeclarationConformance.description:
The per-invocation D1 conformance report: four class-tagged deltas plus
per-class provenance. Emission is unconditional — an invocation with no
capture is exactly the case the provenance vocabulary exists to report.

Tables are application tables only (present in the active schema manifest);
auth/permission dependencies and reserved `_snapback_*` projections are out
of scope by construction.

extraReads.description:
Declared reads unwitnessed by this invocation. Data, not a verdict:
a conditionally-read table is unwitnessed on every invocation that
skips its branch, so over-declaration is only judgeable in aggregate
(D2 coverage).

extraWrites.description: Declared writes unwitnessed by this invocation. Data, not a verdict.

missingReads.description:
Captured reads absent from the declaration — authoritative when
`readProvenance` is `complete`.

missingWrites.description:
Captured writes absent from the declaration — authoritative when
`writeProvenance` is `complete`.

DependencyProvenance.description:
How authoritative one dependency class's captured evidence is for this
invocation.

`Complete` — the runtime captured this class on a supported path; the
matching delta fields are authoritative. `Incomplete` — the invocation
failed, was refused before handler completion, or ran on a seam that
discards the capture; deltas are data, not verdicts. `Unsupported` — the
path constructs no capture by design (actions), so no conformant verdict
can exist.

FunctionAttribution.description:
Server-derived, bearer-free attribution for one app-data function
response. Wrappers may copy this value, but cannot synthesize attribution
authority when the invocation gate did not produce it.

@ref LLP 0055#audit — every resolved service-principal function response
carries the same actor/effective/grant attribution and v1 has no agent
dry-run surface.

FunctionInvocationFacts.description:
Server-derived successful-invocation facts. Keeping the generation under
a named `facts` block leaves room for additive call facts without mixing
them into handler-owned result values.

description:
Successful query/action wire envelope. The function-owned output remains
flattened for compatibility while host-derived attribution and generation
facts stay outside that output contract.

adminBypass.description:
Envelope-level audit fact for session-mode operator invocation. The
handler input remains anonymous; this records that access came through
the explicit administrative bypass rather than an app principal.

conformance.description:
D1 declaration/observation conformance: class-tagged deltas between
the declared and captured table sets with per-class evidence
provenance. Emitted on every runner invocation — a successful action
reports `unsupported` provenance rather than any conformant verdict,
while an action failure reports `incomplete`.
